Tuesday, August 1, 1995  
95-470 - Death Valley (California) - Structural Fire

On July 27th, rangers received a report that a mobile home in the Stovepipe Wells concession housing was fully engulfed in flame. The trailer was unoccupied at the time.

Tuesday, June 14, 1988  
88-103 - Death Valley - Search and Rescue

Location: Valley Salt Pans

A.G. began a solo hike from Bad Water to Telescope Peak on Friday. He was carrying three quarts of water, but drank two shortly after starting the hike and lost the third. Although A.G. then aborted his hike, he was already stressed physically. While out on patrol the following day, a ranger spotted the victim falling down, started an IV, then called for a medevac flight. A.G. was transported to Las Vegas where he is being treated for dehydration and hypothermia.

Thursday, July 25, 1991  
91-323 - Death Valley (California) - Search in Progress

A major search has been begun for P.H., 41, who is overdue from a roundtrip hike from Badwater Springs to Telescope Peak. P.H.'s car was found along the road by ranger patrols on Sunday, July 21st. Daytime temperatures have approached 120 degrees, with ground temperatures above 180 degrees. Because of the high heat, it has not been possible to utilize dog teams.

Monday, July 29, 1991  
91-323 - Death Valley (California) - Followup on Search

On the morning of July 26th, searchers found the body of P.H., 41, a half mile from the Badwater parking area. P.H. had attempted a 20-mile hike to Telescope Peak and back. The cause of death is not yet known.

Wednesday, August 10, 1994  
94-454 - Death Valley (California) - Body Found

On August 6th, rangers received word that a body had been found at the 10,000-foot elevation on the Telescope Peak trail. The victim was listed as a missing person. He'd been dead about 12 hours. The county coroner is conducting an autopsy.

Monday, June 1, 1998  
98-237 - Death Valley NP (CA/NV) - MVA with Fatality

A van went off Big Pine Road and rolled over around noon on May 24th. One occupant who was not wearing a seatbelt was ejected and killed.

Thursday, January 8, 1998  
97-776 - Death Valley NP (CA/NV) - Search and Rescue

S.B. began a 14-mile round trip day hike to Telescope Peak - the highest peak in the park at 11,049 feet - at 9:30 a.m. on the morning of January 4th. The park was notified when he failed to return to the trailhead for a scheduled pickup at 4:30 p.m. S.B. was located in Jail Canyon below the mountain's snow line just after 10 p.m. that evening by a forward-looking infrared device, and was flown out by helicopter. S.B. said he'd attempted a shortcut back to the trailhead. He was in good medical condition although dressed in light clothing and carrying limited food and water.

Wednesday, October 21, 1998  
98-682 - Death Valley NP (CA) - Search and Rescue

D.A. and B.G. began a cross-country hike from Dante's View to Telescope Peak at 8 a.m. on October 12th. This hike would cover approximately 25 miles, beginning at an elevation of 5,704 feet, descending below sea level near Badwater, then ascending to 11,049 feet. On the second day the two became disoriented and stranded in one of the drainages. They advised rangers by cellular phone on the 13th. A helicopter was dispatched and the two men were rescued. They were in good condition, but had run out of water.

Monday, January 4, 1999  
98-778 - Death Valley NP (CA) - Suicide

On December 5th a car was spotted near the information wayside at Hell's Gate. The victim died from a single gunshot wound. The county sheriff's office has assumed responsibility for the case.

Tuesday, June 13, 2000  
00-269 - Death Valley NP (CA) - Heat Stroke Fatality

On June 2nd, an air search began for an overdue hiker in Golden Canyon. Rangers found the body of a 61-year-old visitor. The coroner determined he died of heat stroke. He had carried only 24 ounces of water. The high temperature for the day was 112 degrees.

Monday, August 28, 2000  
00-528 - Death Valley NP (CA) - Search

A vehicle was found near Mahogany Flat campground on Friday, August 18th, and a search was begun for C.M., 26, in the canyons leading off 11,000-foot Telescope Mountain and 10,000-foot Rogers Peak. No sign of C.M. has been found.

Wednesday, September 20, 2000  
00-528 - Death Valley NP (CA) - Follow-up on Search

On September 16th, rangers and a volunteer SAR dog team found C.M.'s body at the 7,500-foot level of Jail Canyon. Evidence at the scene indicated that he died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
